verdict: key consistent once two record words are corrected from the cipher and the page: 80 signs for 81 letters (one alif dropped), one letter per shape except S10, which is د four times and the ذ of منذ once (skeleton-level agreement; the ذ of تذكر has its own comb S19); homophones ن (S4, S14), ا (S13, S18), ب (S17, S23)
notes: Rows 3r l.7-11 on image 0084_0010; l.11 holds 9 cipher signs before the naskh 'وحذف ياء'. Signs per row 18,19,17,17,9 = 80 (record 17,19,15,19,10 = 80); dividers 5,3,3,3,1 = 15 (record 16). Row 7 ends with ه and a divider at x 650-700 left of the segmenter box (missed by it). No divider between منذ and لية, between انها and جت, or at the row 9/10 turn between الحمام and بدوحها; these groups are keyed with overrides. Record errors: (1) 'لتذ' is ل ي ه in the cipher (S8 S11 S6: S11 is ي in سحيرا, لوعتي, وتغريد; S6 is ه/ة in نسمة, بدوحها, انها); the page 3v l.5 has two dots under the tooth, so the word is لية (or ليه), not لتذ. (2) 'تذكرنا عهد' is تذكر | تعديد in the cipher (4 + 5 signs, divider after تذكر; S3 ت, S16 ع, S10 د, S11 ي, S10 د), and the page 3v l.7 reads تذكر تعديد (tooth, ع, د, tooth with two dots below, د): 'the cooing of the doves in its trees, the warbling of a blackbird and the song of nightingales remind [us]'. (3) انها has 3 signs (S14 S6 S13): read as ن ه ا with the initial alif not enciphered; S14 occurs once, so ا with ن dropped is equally possible. ن is otherwise the closed ٩ (S4) and و the open Ч (S15), separated at 3x. The compiler's remark that the speaker's ya was dropped in the first verse is not visible here: لوعتي has its ي (S11). S12 in بدوحها looks like two strokes because a paper hole takes its bottom.
